name: OpenCut
works_with: Web today. The rewrite targets desktop, mobile and browser from one codebase
short: A free, open-source video editor. The current version runs at opencut.app while the team rewrites it from scratch.
what: OpenCut is a free and open-source video editor for web, desktop and mobile. This repo holds a ground-up rewrite with a Rust core. The README lists what's coming: an editor API, third-party plugins, a headless mode for batch rendering, a scripting tab and an MCP server so AI agents can drive it.
who: People who want a free video editor, and developers who want to follow the rewrite. If you just want to edit a video today, the README points you to the classic version.
needs: For the classic version: nothing to install, it runs at opencut.app
To run the rewrite locally: proto, which installs the tools pinned in the repo

steps.title: Use the classic version today
steps.text: opencut.app still runs the classic version. Its code is at github.com/opencut-app/opencut-classic.

steps.title: To run the rewrite, install proto (Linux, macOS, WSL)
Install the pinned tools from the repo root
Start the apps
steps.code:
moon run web:dev       # localhost:5173
moon run api:dev       # localhost:8787

try.label: From the README
try.text: Open opencut.app to use the classic editor. The rewrite will live at new.opencut.app until it's ready to take over.

watch: Both proto installers pipe a script from the internet straight into your shell. Read the script before you run it.
The rewrite is early. The API, plugins, headless mode and MCP server are listed as coming.
The team isn't taking outside contributions yet while the architecture is being designed.
